notes: Sheet music: open a hymn and tap Show notes to see its music. 506 hymns have it so far, with more to come as they are checked.
Eight hymns, among them 1, 14 and 677, show the words between the staves as in the hymnal. The rest show the verses below the music.
Music you have opened is kept on your phone, so it shows without signal too.
A new look in the colours of Sovereign Grace Church, with the church logo.
Works without signal again. The app, and any tune you have played, are kept on your phone.
Tapping numbers quickly on the keypad no longer zooms the screen.
